description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [0.43.0] - 2026-08-21

### 🚀 Features

- *(sidebar)* Collapse rail to icons, expand on hover
- *(nav)* Add quick profile switcher, split Profile from Settings
- *(hero)* Drop Play, rename More Info to View Details

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(card)* Drop the redundant three-dot button from card actions
- *(detail)* Series actions, Specials ordering, episode context menu

### 🎨 Styling

- Visual pass on sidebar, hero, cards and detail page

## [0.42.0] - 2026-08-21

### 🚀 Features

- *(detail)* Show real episode banners, richer metadata and trailers
- *(settings)* Group settings into an Account/Playback/Sessions/About sidebar

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(home)* Stop an in-progress episode also showing in Up Next
- *(card)* Drop the Play button from card action bars

## [0.41.0] - 2026-08-21

### 🚀 Features

- Add because-you're-watching, top genre and top actor home rows

### ⚡ Performance

- Cache filmography, watchlist and seasons/episodes lookups
- Parallelize the settings screen's own independent requests
- Make the anime library screen fire and forget
- Right-size and compress card, coverflow and person images
- Batch large item grids instead of rendering them all at once
- Gzip/brotli compress served JS, CSS and SVG
